instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Croatian tweet convey, judged from its tone and from the valence of what it reports or shares?
instructions.rule: Negative needs the poster to be bothered or attacking: their own complaint, mishap or suffering (even joked about), annoyance, targeted sarcasm, moralising, or bad news (crisis, conflict, criticism, accusation, lawsuit, death, scandal). Good news is positive even in economy or politics (growth, recovery, profit, record, success). Conversational @replies, banter, deadpan observations, statistics, directionless political events, religious texts and horoscopes are neutral; a smiley alone does not make a reply positive. Shares of culture, entertainment, tech, teasers, tips, ads, check-ins, help appeals, and replies with explicit warmth or cheering are positive.

neutral.what: Casual @reply chat, banter, practical answers, plain questions. Statistics, dividends, line-ups. Political or institutional events with no good or bad direction. Religious texts, horoscopes. Deadpan observations about others.
examples: @pcelamed očito :)) Kronike iz Narnije su na rtl-u (obviously :)) Chronicles of Narnia is on RTL)

Mama gleda njemačku Bachelorette. Žena gleda američki Masterchef. Počinjem štedjet za treći televizor. (Mom watches German Bachelorette. My wife watches American Masterchef. I'm starting to save for a third TV.)
Ne propustite večeras debatu kandidata za predsjednika @EU_Commission @hrtvijesti http://t.co/EgGMQ2dir7 (Don't miss tonight's debate of candidates for Commission president)
neutral.cues: @reply + :), haha, sabor (parliament), debata (debate), dividenda (dividend), horoskop, numbers
neutral.not_for: The poster's own annoyance or mishap, or bad news, go negative. Good news and promotional shares go positive.

positive.what: Explicit joy, praise, thanks, love, cheering. Good news (growth, profit, records, recovery, success). Shares of events, culture, celebrities, tech, article teasers, recipes, ads, check-ins, help appeals.
examples: Pula: Na Giardinima započela 8. Florija, sajam cvijeća u sklopu obilježavanja Dana Grada: https://t.co/6Jbezcjeer (Pula: the 8th Florija flower fair started at Giardini)
Dobit Facebooka skočila 138 posto, cijena dionice rekordna http://t.co/LL7vWrePKr (Facebook profit jumped 138 percent, share price at a record)
RT @amaiia_hr: #Zagreb - Volonteri traže prijevoz do poplavljenih područja #poplave (Volunteers seek transport to flooded areas)
positive.cues: festival, ponuda (offer), rekord (record), oporavak (recovery), pročitajte (read), pomozimo (let's help), hvala (thanks), volim (I love), ajmo (let's go), I'm at
positive.not_for: Smileys on complaints or digs go negative. Casual @reply chat with only a smiley goes neutral.

negative.what: The poster complains, suffers a mishap, is annoyed, sad or worried, insults, mocks or moralises. Also bad news: crises, debt, conflicts, harsh criticism, accusations, lawsuits, deaths, mourning, scandals.
examples: Naravno, opet kiša u Brusselsu. (Of course, rain in Brussels again.)
Putin na presici žestoko kritizira novo ukrajinsko vodstvo: 'Vojna akcija protiv Ukrajine će biti posljednja opcija!' (Putin harshly criticizes the new Ukrainian leadership)
@LucijaCavric oho i ovdje si finjak :P (oho, you're being posh here too)
negative.cues: opet (again), jebiga (damn it), mrzim (I hate), sranje (crap), grozan (awful), kritizira (criticizes), žalost (mourning), dug (debt), :(, :S
negative.not_for: Help appeals go positive. Witty observations about others and calm opinions go neutral.
